Package sc.fiji.snt.gui

Record Class GuidedTutorial.Step

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
sc.fiji.snt.gui.GuidedTutorial.Step
Record Components:
message - the (HTML-capable) callout text
roi - world-coordinate region to fly the camera to before showing the callout (null keeps the current view, e.g. for a step that reuses the previous one's framing)
isDone - checked once the user dismisses this step's callout; true advances to the next step, false re-shows retryIndex()
retryIndex - the (0-based) step index to fall back to when isDone fails; a negative value retries this same step (see of(java.lang.String, sc.fiji.snt.util.BoundingBox, java.util.function.BooleanSupplier))
calloutTarget - resolves a real on-screen control to anchor the callout to instead of the roi's on-screen center (see pointingAt(java.util.function.Function<sc.fiji.snt.viewer.AbstractBigViewer, java.awt.Component>)); null (the common case) keeps the default canvas-center anchor. roi, if any, still just frames the camera either way
Enclosing class:
GuidedTutorial

    • of

      public static GuidedTutorial.Step of(String message, BoundingBox roi, BooleanSupplier isDone, Consumer<AbstractBigViewer> cameraAction)
      Same as of(String, BoundingBox, BooleanSupplier), but also runs cameraAction (e.g. GuidedTutorial.rotate(int, double, long)) right after roi is flown to.

    • pointingAt

      public GuidedTutorial.Step pointingAt(Function<AbstractBigViewer,Component> calloutTarget)
      Same step, but anchoring the callout to a real on-screen control - e.g. v -> v.getNavigationModeButton() - instead of the roi's on-screen center. Useful for a step that explains a UI control rather than a location in the 3D scene; roi (if any) still just frames the camera as usual. A resolver that returns null (the control not built/showing yet) falls back to the default canvas-center anchor.
